column1: Structures have 25% more health and resist 15% of ballistic gun and rocket damage. Repair depots maintain nearby armor within 5 m for free. Depots unlock Sentinels; Coordination unlocks siege armor. Anchor sectors reward holding ground.
column2: 建筑生命值提高 25%，受到枪炮与火箭等弹道武器的伤害降低 15%。维修站免费维护 5 米内的附近装甲单位。维修站解锁哨兵机甲；协同研究解锁攻城装甲。锚定扇区适合坚守阵地。

column1: Bastion bulkheads: +25% structure health and 15% less damage from ballistic guns and rockets. Energy weapons ignore this protection.
column2: 堡垒复合舱壁：建筑生命值提高 25%，受到枪炮与火箭等弹道武器的伤害降低 15%。能量武器不受此防护影响。

column1: Automatically repairs one adjacent ground vehicle within 5 m at no resource cost. Extra service slot with Siege Logistics. Repairs do not stack. Uses 3 power.
column2: 自动免费维修 5 米内的一辆附近地面载具。攻城后勤研究增加一个维修机位。维修效果不可叠加。消耗 3 点电力。

column1: Repairs one mechanical ground ally or completed building at a time, at no resource cost. 3 m reach, measured from a building's edge.
column2: 免费维修一台友方地面机械单位或一座已完成的建筑。范围为 3 米；维修建筑时从其边缘计算距离。
